source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of synthesis and retrosynthesis (PDF 134-135).

blocks.text: Organic compound banane se pehle har qadam ke liye darkaar reactions, reagents aur halaat samajhna zaroori hai taa ke target molecule kamyabi se bane. Zyada tar organic compounds kai raaston se ban sakte hain, aur behtareen raasta chunne ke liye mayaar chahiye. Achhi synthesis saste, aasani se milne wale shuruati maaddon ko kam se kam qadmon aur zyada kul miqdar (yield) wale raaste se product mein badalti hai.

Bohat se maloom reactions is lihaz se taqseem ho sakte hain ke yeh functional group interconversions (FGI) karte hain ya carbon-carbon bond banate hain. C-C bond banana khaas taur par ahem hai, kyunke synthesis ki bunyadi hikmat-e-amali target molecule ko chhote shuruati maaddon se jorna hai.

blocks.prompt: Synthesis ka raasta achha kis cheez se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Saste, aasani se milne wale shuruati maadde, kam se kam qadam aur zyada kul yield.

items: Har qadam ka reaction, reagent aur halaat jaanein.
Behtareen raasta: saste shuruati maadde, kam qadam, zyada yield.
Reactions: FGI ya C-C bond banana.
